terms.summary: Names VeryIcon as the source of the icons. The repository has no license file, and GitHub reports no license.

Attributes the pack to AIyangyang and states it is free for personal and commercial purpose. This is the site's claim. It does not show authorization from Huawei or address redistribution in a plugin.
Huawei Cloud's site terms reserve its rights in its marks and logos. They govern Huawei's own site, and they show why no permission can be inferred for these icons.

conditions: Private personal use by the owner only, under D-017. This is the owner's acceptance of the rights risk, not permission from any rights holder
Rights are not cleared and redistribution permission is not established
Do not make this repository public, publish this package or plugin, or share these files. Git history keeps them, so going public would first require removing them from history
Sharing generated diagrams that show these icons outside private use is not covered by D-017
packs.attribution: Huawei Cloud service icons, repacked by JuanDiaz00 from the VeryIcon pack HUAWEI CLOUD Service Icon, which VeryIcon attributes to AIyangyang. Huawei Cloud names and marks belong to Huawei.
packs.blocker_reason: Public distribution of these icons stays blocked. D-017 accepts the rights risk for the owner's private personal use only, and no redistribution permission has been established.

No icon in the accepted private pack clearly matches these services. Huawei's official library and the LATAM library are not accepted: their rights are unresolved under O-002, and D-017 covers only the JuanDiaz00 pack. No generic icon is substituted.
